params.caption: 🎮 McDonald's lets you order food without leaving your GTA 6 session Timing it with GTA 6's launch, McDonald's in the US has teamed up with Discord. A McDonald's activity inside Discord, which also works on console, lets players place a McDelivery order through Uber Eats and get straight back to the game. 🕒 Nov 18, 2026 · 18:00 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GameSpot 👥 @RockstarGames 🍔 Genius or lazy?
